explanation: Compared against OEIS A234246 conjecture (iv): if n > 7 and n ∉ {10, 19}, then (φ(k) + φ(n−k))/2 is triangular for some 0 < k < n. The statement uses φ(k) + φ(n−k) = m(m+1), which is equivalent: triangular numbers are m(m+1)/2, and the halving is integral exactly when the sum is even. Faithful.
